entries.title: Psalms 54:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments: an instruction. Of David; when the Ziphites came, and said to Saul, Is not David hiding himself with us?>> O God, by thy name save me, and by thy strength do me justice.

entries.title: Psalms 54:2
segments: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 54:3
segments: For strangers are risen up against me, and the violent seek after my life: they have not set God before them. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 54:4
segments: ¶Behold, God is my helper; the Lord is among them that uphold my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 54:5
segments: He will requite evil to mine enemies: in thy truth cut them off.

entries.title: Psalms 54:6
segments: I will freely sacrifice unto thee; I will praise thy name, O Jehovah, because it is good.

entries.title: Psalms 54:7
segments: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; and mine eye hath seen [its desire] upon mine enemies.
